title: Thai-Style Chicken Skewers with Smoky Portuguese Flavor
description: A twist on traditional Thai street food, these smoky chicken skewers are infused with the bold flavors of Portuguese cuisine.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together coconut oil, brown sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, and smoked paprika.
3. Add chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with marinade.
4. Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through.
6. Meanwhile, mix together chopped peanuts, green onions, and chili flakes in a small bowl.
7. Serve grilled skewers with peanut-greens mixture sprinkled on top.
8. Garnish with additional green onions and peanuts, if desired.
